text:
Maya (CS): Quick harvest from this week's onboarding calls — two consistent asks we should triage: 1) customers want clearer per-route billing visibility (can't map routes -> cost), 2) embedding latency spikes causing poor search/UX. Can we prioritize? @Liam (PM) @Arjun (Eng) please weigh in.

Jess (Onboarding): Saw the same patterns in two mid-market pilots. Per-route billing is a procurement blocker for one of them.

Sam (Account): I flagged that in the renewal call yesterday. If we don't give them a breakdown they won't move forward. I can share the example invoice they're asking about.

Maya (CS): Pasting a few short quotes from calls:

```
"We need to see cost by route before we can run this in prod."
"Embedding latency is making our search feel flaky — users think it's broken."
"If we can't explain per-route charges, procurement will push back on our renewal."
```

Arjun (Eng): For embeddings latency — do we know if this is model choice or infra (batching, cache TTL)? I saw one customer with a misconfigured KV cache causing repeated cold-starts.

feedback-bot: New signal captured: "embedding lag hurts search flow" (NPS note id=8421).

Liam (PM): Thanks — sounds like two tracks: short-term mitigations + longer-term product work. Proposal:
- Short-term (this sprint): publish a simple per-route cost explainer + export example so AMs can share. Run a focused perf test for embeddings on at-risk accounts.
- Long-term: Console feature to show `per-route` consumption & cost breakdown, and embedding latency dashboards.

Liam (PM): Asking @Sam to own customer comms for the two renewal-risk accounts; @Jess can own a short enablement one-pager. @Arjun can scope perf test (estimate hours). I'll slot billing visibility into the product triage next Wed.

Sam (Account): :thumbsup: I'll draft the breakdown sample and attach the invoice example by EOD.

Jess (Onboarding): I'll make a 1-slide + checklist for AMs and a short how-to for customers explaining routes -> billing.

Arjun (Eng): I'll run a 2-hour perf surface for embeddings (model/seq length/batching) and share numbers. If KV cache TTL is root cause I'll push a quick config fix.

Maya (CS): Great — I've added these items to the CS signal board: https://redwood.internal/cs-signals/5201234567 and marked per-route billing as P1 for the two at-risk renewals. Thanks all.

Liam (PM): I'll update the roadmap note after we get Sam's invoice sample.

Maya (CS): tagging here so product can prioritize accordingly — thanks everyone for quick responses. :sparkles:
